title: 02 Orrery: luminous dev-tool hero
strengths: The product fragments are believable: a results table with cosine scores and a plausible query, a nine-line code sample with a real-looking API, a P99 latency chip with a sparkline
Stats row uses mono numbers with small-caps captions (8.7 ms, 99.2%, Apache 2.0) the way engineers read
Nav is restrained: plain links, 'Sign in', one outlined 'Talk to an engineer'
slop_signals: A teal galaxy with orbit rings and a glowing 'query star' fills the top right for atmosphere; the glow has no job once the rings are read as the logo
Three product cards tilted in perspective with soft shadows at different depths: the Dribbble 'floating UI' move
'3.2 Hybrid search: dense and sparse vectors in one query ->' pill badge above the headline
'Used in production by' row of five invented wordmarks (kelvinlabs, FERNWAY, parabola/, Quillmark, Atlas & Ivy)
Filled teal CTA with a glow halo plus a second terminal-styled button: the two-button stack
Starfield particles scattered across the whole ground, including behind the body text
fixes: Flatten the product: one results panel face-on bleeding off the right edge, the code sample docked to it as a tab, as Supabase and ReadMe do; no perspective tilt
Keep the orrery as a thin line drawing (rings and a dot) and remove the glow, the stars and the nebula fill
Replace the fake logo row with one line the company would actually have: a GitHub star count, a benchmark link or a changelog line
Move the version note into the nav as a small 'v3.2' link and remove the pill
One CTA; show 'pip install orrery' as plain mono text with a copy icon, not a second button

references.what: Table and code card overlap flat on a dark ground, no glow, no tilt, two small buttons; the overlap alone gives depth
A vector-product hero on dark with one icon, a faint grid and a few particles; shows how little atmosphere is needed
Stats, a request table and a side panel on a hairline grid, all face-on; data as the picture
Dark dev-tool hero with the product bleeding right and small plain buttons; the grid lines do what our glow tries to do
Same split (headline left, floating objects right) with two plain buttons and no badge; the floating objects are real app icons, not UI fragments

changed: Renamed Orrery to Nearmost: Embedding Orrery (embedding-orrery.com) is a real open-source embedding search tool, and pip install orrery installs a real unrelated package
Removed the canvas galaxy, glow, stars, tilted floating cards, the 3.2 pill, the invented logo row, the stat trio and the second button

The product is the picture: a flat, whole console with a query bar, a UMAP map of the 2,000 nearest vectors (topic regions, query crosshair, numbered results, filtered papers), a results table with an honest hybrid score (0.7 dense + 0.3 sparse, computed per row) and a query-plan trace that adds to 7.9 ms
The headline is the number: 8.7 ms at 148 px, then the sentence it completes; one button and pip install as plain text; facts and a measurement footnote at the bottom
Product secondary text raised from 12 to 14 px; the selected row is visible (neutral fill, ink rule); teal marks only the button, the logo dot and the results

facts: mockups/04-browser-cascade/index.html line 71 still captions this piece 'Orrery'
opendesigner/build/dtcg/orrery.resolver.json is a stale export from before the rename (engine build does not remove it)

pairwise.note: Judged on the first round-4 render; later changes only removed marks from the map and the teal from the result dots.

changed: Title in this file fixed: the '# ' line said Orrery, so the gallery captioned the piece with the old brand
The 148 px '8.7 ms' headline is gone; the headline is now the claim in words, 'Search a billion vectors by meaning.', at the 67 px token, with 8.7 ms at p99 in the one supporting line

Headline on the left, the statement and one button beside it (the pip install line, the facts row and the footnote are gone); the console runs full width below and is cropped by the foot of the frame through its result rows, so the 230 px dead band is gone

Console cut from four panels to two: the results (now 10, with dense and sparse scores shown so the 0.7 + 0.3 score can be checked) and the map. The query plan, the map legend, two of the three filter chips, the hollow 'filtered' rings and the numbers on nine of the ten map dots are gone; half the background points are gone
Teal has one job, the button; the selected row has one signal (a fill)
'GitHub' in the nav (a real brand) is now 'Open source'
